cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Not That Subject
cards.instruction: Choose one subject you cannot let the scene reach. Redirect whenever the conversation gets close.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've booked your car into the garage. Let me fill in the repair form; mechanics need precise terminology.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We start with the registration, not speculation. Can you read it to me?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I know the registration. I want to know why the door won't close.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: 'Door' is insufficient. Driver's side or passenger's side? Please let me complete one field properly.

heightening.evidence: A5 turns a concrete symptom into another required field while refusing the cause again.
